seo.description: 151 Coffee is a fast drive-thru coffee shop serving handcrafted espresso, cold brew, energy drinks, smoothies, teas and breakfast across Texas and Kansas.

items.answer: 151 Coffee is a fast drive-thru coffee concept serving handcrafted espresso, cold brew, and blended energy drinks across Texas and Kansas. Founded in 2017 by Mark Wattles, we live by one motto: It's a good day to have a good day.
items.question: What is 151 Coffee?

items.answer: We currently have 12+ locations across the Dallas-Fort Worth metro in Texas and 3 in Kansas. Use the locator on our homepage or visit the Locations page to find the nearest store.
items.question: Where is 151 Coffee located?

items.answer: Our menu includes espresso drinks, cold brew, blended energy drinks, dirty sodas (Dirty Pops), refreshers, smoothies, teas, kids drinks, hot food items like burritos and bagels, and baked treats. With over 43,000 flavor combinations, there's something for everyone.
items.question: What does 151 Coffee serve?

items.answer: Yes! Every 151 Coffee location has a drive-thru concept, and an outdoor walk-up area as well. Speed and convenience are central to what we do. Our dual-lane drive-thru design and outdoor order-takers help us move fast even during peak hours.
items.question: Does 151 Coffee have a drive-thru?

items.answer: Yes! You can purchase check gift cards in-store, and check gift card balances using the Gift Card button at the bottom of the page.
items.question: Does 151 Coffee sell gift cards?

items.answer: Always. Visit our Careers page to see current openings. We look for people who are energetic, positive, and passionate about great customer experiences.

seo.title: About 151 Coffee | Our Story & Founder Mark Wattles
seo.description: 151 Coffee is not your typical coffee shop. Founded in 2017 by entrepreneur Mark Wattles, we serve the best-tasting coffee and blended energy drinks fast.

hero.heading: About 151 Coffee
hero.subheading: It's a Good Day to Have a Good Day.

intro.heading: Not Your Typical
intro.tagline: It's a Good Day to have a Good Day.

paragraphs.value: 151 Coffee is not your typical coffee shop. Fun and happiness drive our culture and music drives our speed, that's why we live by the 151 motto "It's a good day to have a good day."

Each of our drive-thru stores serves the best tasting coffee and blended energy drinks faster than anyone. If you're thirsty and looking for a tasty beverage to buzz your day, swing through our drive thru, say hi, and drive with the 151 vibe.

bio.value: Mark is a highly accomplished entrepreneur with a strong background in business development and growth. Born and raised in both Santa Monica and Texas, he developed a passion for surfing, wakeboarding, and snowboarding from a young age.
Instead of pursuing a traditional college education, Mark chose to dive into the world of business and has since built an impressive portfolio of successful national ventures.

image.alt: Our founder, Mark Wattles at our Coppell store on launch day.

meta_data.alt: Our founder, Mark Wattles at our Coppell store on launch day.

ventures.desc: Started in 1988. Grew from one store to 1,000 corporate-owned stores in just ten years - reaching $2 Billion in revenue and 2,000 company-owned stores. Sold in 2005.
ventures.name: Hollywood Entertainment, Inc.

ventures.desc: Co-founder of the B2C online home improvement marketplace. Sold to IAC/InterActiveCorp (Nasdaq: IAC).
ventures.name: HomeAdvisor.com

ventures.desc: One of four partners who built this full-service restaurant chain to 45 locations across 18 states. Named a "breakout brand" by Nation's Restaurant News. Majority stake sold to Angelo Gordon.
ventures.name: Firebirds Wood Fired Grill

body.value: 151 Coffee is a whole new coffee concept started in 2017. 151 Coffee is founded and funded by Mark Wattles, who has founded and financed multiple national $100MM to $2B companies, including restaurants, B2C online companies, and a 2000 store retail chain that opened a new store a day at its peak.
At 151, we intend to leverage the experience of our founder and the 151 Team to grow rapidly and create opportunities for our employees while never forgetting our #1 mission: to have fun!

timeline.text: First 151 Coffee location opens in the Dallas Fort Worth area. A new coffee concept is born.
Second location opens in Flower Mound, TX. The brand begins to take root across the DFW metro.
Thirteen more locations open across Texas, followed by expansion into Kansas - Lawrence, Manhattan, and Overland Park.
16 locations operating across Texas and Kansas, with several more in progress and many opening soon. The goal: 2,000 stores by the end of 2038.

seo.title: Privacy Policy | 151 Coffee
seo.description: 151 Coffee privacy policy - how we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you contact us through our website, sign up for communications, or submit a form. This may include your name, email address, phone number, and message content.
sections.heading: Information We Collect

sections.body: We use the information we collect to respond to your inquiries, send you updates and promotional materials (with your consent), improve our website and services, and comply with legal obligations.
sections.heading: How We Use Your Information

sections.body: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except as required by law or to trusted partners who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business.
sections.heading: Information Sharing

sections.body: Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You may choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect certain features of our site.
sections.heading: Cookies

sections.body: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to review their privacy policies.
sections.heading: Third-Party Services

sections.body: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
sections.heading: Data Security

sections.body: Our website is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
sections.heading: Children's Privacy

sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at Contact@151Coffee.com.
sections.heading: Contact Us

content.name: Pumpkin Spice Chai

content.name: Pumpkin Spice Latte

content.name: Green Chile Burrito

content.description: A hearty breakfast burrito packed with fluffy scrambled eggs, melted cheese, and roasted green chile for a little kick to start your day.

content.name: Whookie GF Cookie
content.subtitle: Chocolate Sandwich Cookie - Gluten Free
content.description: A gluten-free chocolate sandwich cookie that doesn't play it safe. Rich, chocolatey, and satisfying in every bite.

content.name: Snickerdoodle
content.subtitle: Cinnamon Sugar Classic
content.description: Soft and perfectly spiced with cinnamon sugar. The snickerdoodle is the cookie that always disappears first. You already know.

content.name: Sea Salt Chocolate Chip
content.subtitle: Classic Chocolate Chip with a Sea Salt Finish
content.description: The cookie that needs no introduction. A gooey chocolate chip with a flaky sea salt finish that makes the chocolate sing. Pairs perfectly with everything on the menu.

content.name: Pumpkin Spice Bread
content.subtitle: Warm Spiced Pumpkin Loaf
content.description: A warmly spiced pumpkin loaf that's tender, aromatic, and exactly what you want alongside a hot coffee. Seasonal flavor, all-the-time worthy.

content.name: Peanut Butter Cookie
content.subtitle: Rich & Chewy Peanut Butter Cookie
content.description: Dense, rich, and perfectly chewy. Made for peanut butter people, the ones who don't mess around when it comes to their cookies.

content.name: Lemon Pound Cake
content.subtitle: Bright & Buttery
content.description: Dense, buttery pound cake with a bright lemon punch. The kind of thing you eat half of before you get home.

content.name: "Hippie" GF Cookie
content.subtitle: Oatmeal & Cranberries - Gluten Free
content.description: Hearty oatmeal and sweet cranberries baked into a gluten-free cookie that actually tastes great. No compromise on flavor, just a different kind of cookie for a different kind of person.

content.name: Cinnamon Chip Crumbcake
content.subtitle: Muffin Top
content.description: All muffin top, no muffin stump. Packed with cinnamon chips and topped with a crumble crust that makes every bite feel like the best part.

content.name: Cake Pops
content.subtitle: Birthday Cake, Cookies & Cream, or Triple Chocolate
content.description: Three flavors, zero wrong answers. Birthday Cake, Cookies & Cream, and Triple Chocolate. Grab one (or all three) for the road.

content.name: Blueberry-Lemon Muffin Top
content.subtitle: Tangy & Sweet
content.description: Bursting blueberries and bright lemon zest baked into a golden muffin top. Tangy, sweet, and perfectly domed. It's the muffin top that earns its reputation.

content.name: Banana Walnut Bread
content.subtitle: Moist & Classic
content.description: Moist banana bread loaded with walnuts, and it tastes like someone's grandmother made it. Comfort food at its finest.

content.name: Sweet Tea
content.subtitle: Black Tea with Cane Sugar
content.description: Real brewed black tea sweetened with cane sugar the proper way. Cold, refreshing, and the most honest drink on the menu.

content.name: Pomekazi
content.subtitle: Pomegranate & Peach
content.description: Pomegranate and peach join forces in a bright, fruity iced tea that's refreshing from first sip to last.

content.name: Georgia Peach
content.subtitle: Strawberry & Peach
content.description: Brewed tea infused with sweet strawberry and ripe peach. The afternoon pick-me up that doesn't require caffeine to be satisfying.

content.name: Berry Refresher
content.subtitle: Strawberry & Raspberry
content.description: Two bold berries brewed into a bright, tangy iced tea. Simple, refreshing, and the color alone will make you smile.

content.name: Strawberry Lemonade
content.subtitle: Fresh & Tangy
content.description: Real strawberry and bright lemon blended into a tangy-sweet smoothie that hits every note. Fresh, bold, and perfectly tart.

content.name: Pina Colada
content.subtitle: Coconut & Pineapple
content.description: Creamy coconut and tangy pineapple blended thick. The classic poolside flavor, no umbrella required.

content.name: Georgia Peach
content.subtitle: Strawberry & Peach
content.description: Sun-ripened peach meets sweet strawberry in a smoothie that tastes like a summer afternoon. Thick, fruity, and deeply satisfying.

content.name: Aloha
content.subtitle: Strawberry, Mango & Pineapple
content.description: Three fruits, zero regrets. Strawberry, mango, and pineapple blended into a thick, vibrant smoothie that brings the islands to your cup holder.

content.name: Purple Dragon
content.subtitle: Lavender, Mango, Diced Dragon Fruit, Coconut Cream
content.description: Lavender and mango float above diced dragon fruit and a swirl of coconut cream. Bold, beautiful, and packed with tropical flavor.

content.name: Pink Drink
content.subtitle: Strawberry, Passion Fruit, Coconut Milk
content.description: Light, fruity, and impossibly pretty. Strawberry and passion fruit swirl together with coconut milk for a refresher that's as good as it looks.

content.name: Peaches & Cream
content.subtitle: Peach Puree & Vanilla Cream
content.description: Sweet peach puree meets silky vanilla cream in the simplest, most satisfying refresher on the menu. Classic and crowd-pleasing every single time.

content.name: Mango Dream
content.subtitle: Mango Puree, SF Vanilla, Diced Mango, Coconut Cream
content.description: Real mango puree, diced mango pieces, and SF vanilla all tied together with coconut cream. A full tropical experience in every sip.

content.name: Hot Cocoa
content.subtitle: Rich & Creamy
content.description: A warm, rich cup of real hot cocoa made just right for the little ones. Creamy, comforting, and impossible to say no to.

content.name: Hot Cider
content.subtitle: Warm Apple Cider
content.description: Warm, spiced apple cider that feels like a hug in a cup. Perfect for cooler mornings when the kids want something cozy.

content.name: Chocolate Milk
content.subtitle: Cold & Delicious
content.description: Cold, creamy, chocolatey. A drive-thru essential for kids who know what they want. Simple and perfectly satisfying every time.

content.name: Apple Juice
content.subtitle: Fresh & Sweet
content.description: Fresh, sweet apple juice served cold. The classic kid's drink.

content.name: The Ultimate Burrito
content.subtitle: Egg, Jack & Cheddar, Bacon, Sausage, Hash Browns & Gravy
content.description: If you're going to do breakfast, do it right. Egg, two kinds of meat, melted cheese, hash browns, and gravy all wrapped into one. The name says it all.

content.name: Sticky Bun Coffee Cake
content.subtitle: Served Warm
content.description: Warm, gooey, and dangerously good. A sticky bun coffee cake served fresh. You'll be thinking about on the drive home.

content.name: Maple Waffle
content.subtitle: Sausage & Egg on a Maple Waffle
content.description: Sweet meets savory on a golden maple waffle with a sausage patty and egg. The perfect balance of morning flavors in one handheld bite.

content.name: Jalapeno Biscuit
content.subtitle: Spicy Sausage, Egg & Cheese on a Jalapeno Cheddar Biscuit
content.description: A flaky, spicy jalapeno cheddar biscuit stacked with spicy sausage, egg, and cheese. For the ones who like their mornings with a kick.

content.name: Everything Bagel
content.subtitle: Spicy Sausage, Egg & Cheese on an Everything Bagel
content.description: Toasted everything bagel loaded with a spicy sausage patty, egg, and melted cheese. Bold flavor, satisfying crunch. It's the breakfast sandwich for people who don't do boring.

content.name: Egg White Frittata
content.subtitle: Spinach, Feta & Roasted Red Pepper
content.description: Light and satisfying. Egg whites baked with spinach, salty feta, and sweet roasted red pepper. Proof that eating well doesn't have to mean eating bland.

content.name: Chorizo Burrito
content.subtitle: Egg, Jack & Cheddar, Chorizo, Hash Browns & Sour Cream
content.description: A packed breakfast burrito loaded with scrambled egg, melted jack and cheddar, smoky chorizo, crispy hash browns, and sour cream. Grab and go, no regrets.

content.name: Bacon Cheddar Egg Bites
content.subtitle: Three Per Order
content.description: Three tender, protein-packed egg bites loaded with crispy bacon and sharp cheddar. Small but mighty, they're exactly what a busy morning needs.

content.name: Tigers Blood
content.subtitle: Strawberry & Coconut
content.description: A tropical punch of strawberry and coconut blended into an energy drink that tastes like summer. Bright, fruity, and ready to fuel your day.

content.name: Starry Night
content.subtitle: Red Raspberry & Blue Raspberry
content.description: Two berries collide in a deep, berry-packed energy drink that's as bold in flavor as it is in color. Smooth and seriously refreshing.

content.name: Ocean Water
content.subtitle: Blue Raspberry, Lime & Coconut
content.description: A cooling blue wave of raspberry, lime, and coconut that tastes exactly like its name. Vibrant, refreshing, and borderline addictive.

content.name: Jolly Rancher
content.subtitle: Blue Raspberry & Green Apple
content.description: Tart green apple meets blue raspberry in a nostalgic, candy-inspired energy drink. Sweet, sour, and impossible to put down.

content.name: Texas Special
content.subtitle: Dr. Pepper, Vanilla & Coconut Cream
content.description: A Texas staple. Dr. Pepper gets dressed up with vanilla syrup and a pour of coconut cream. Sweet, creamy, and unapologetically Texan.

content.name: Smooth Classic
content.subtitle: Pepsi, Coconut, Vanilla & Half & Half
content.description: Pepsi elevated with coconut, vanilla, and a pour of half & half. Creamy, smooth, and just enough of a twist to make it feel like a whole new drink.

content.name: Just Dew It
content.subtitle: Mt. Dew, Strawberry & Mango Puree
content.description: Mt. Dew gets a tropical makeover with real strawberry and mango puree. Bold citrus meets sweet fruit in one impossibly refreshing sip.

content.name: Dr. Feel Good
content.subtitle: Dr. Pepper, Raspberry Puree & Coconut Cream
content.description: Dr. Pepper meets real raspberry puree and coconut cream for a fruity, creamy soda experience. One sip and you'll know exactly why it's called what it's called.

content.name: Cast Away
content.subtitle: Sprite, Coconut, Mango Puree & Fresh Lime
content.description: Close your eyes, you're on a beach. Sprite, coconut, mango puree, and fresh lime come together in a tropical escape you can sip through a drive-thru window.

content.name: Butter Brew
content.subtitle: Root Beer, Butterscotch & Vanilla Cream
content.description: Root beer floats aside, this one levels up with butterscotch syrup and vanilla cream. Rich, nostalgic, and dangerously smooth.

content.name: Snickers
content.subtitle: Hazelnut & Caramel, Chocolate Milk
content.description: The beloved candy bar gets the cold brew treatment. Hazelnut, caramel, and chocolate milk meet slow-steeped coffee for an indulgent cold sip.

content.name: Nitro Brew
content.subtitle: Velvety Nitro-Infused Cold Brew
content.description: Cold brew infused with nitrogen for a velvety, almost creamy texture with a cascading pour. Naturally bold yet smooth. This one's in a league of its own.

content.name: French Toast
content.subtitle: White Chocolate & Brown Sugar Cinnamon
content.description: Cold brew steeped in the flavors of Sunday morning. White chocolate and brown sugar cinnamon transform your coffee into something that tastes like brunch.

content.name: Cold Brew
content.subtitle: Smooth & Bold
content.description: Slow-steeped for 18 hours for a concentrate that's smoother and less acidic than regular iced coffee. Clean, bold, and built to carry you through the day.

content.name: Caramel Blondie
content.subtitle: Caramel & Vanilla
content.description: All the sweet, golden flavors you want in one cup. One of our fan favorites.

content.name: 151 Mocha
content.subtitle: Dark Chocolate & Milk
content.description: Bold cold brew meets rich chocolate. Deep, smooth, and unapologetically chocolatey.

content.name: White Chocolate Macadamia
content.subtitle: White Chocolate & Macadamia Nut
content.description: Silky white chocolate pairs with the buttery richness of macadamia nut for a latte that feels like a dessert. Smooth, sweet, and totally memorable.

content.name: Snickers
content.subtitle: Hazelnut & Caramel, Chocolate Milk
content.description: Everything you love about the classic candy bar. Hazelnut and caramel blended into a bold espresso drink made with chocolate milk.

content.name: Latte
content.subtitle: Smooth Espresso & Milk
content.description: Freshly pulled espresso meets steamed milk in the drink that never lets you down. Simple, smooth, and always satisfying.

content.name: Irish Sin
content.subtitle: Irish Cream
content.description: A smooth espresso drink with the creamy, slightly sweet flavor of Irish cream. Rich, velvety, and dangerously easy to drink.

content.name: Hot Cocoa
content.subtitle: Rich Creamy Chocolate
content.description: Real, rich chocolate blended into a creamy, warming mug of cocoa. The grown-up version of the childhood classic.

content.name: German Chocolate
content.subtitle: Coconut & Caramel, Chocolate Milk
content.description: Inspired by the beloved cake. Coconut and caramel swirl through rich chocolate milk and espresso. Toasty, sweet, and deeply satisfying.

content.name: Cinnamon Dulce
content.subtitle: Brown Sugar Cinnamon & Caramel
content.description: Warm brown sugar cinnamon meets buttery caramel in this cozy, spiced espresso drink. It tastes like fall in a cup, any time of year.

content.name: Chai Latte
content.subtitle: Spiced Chai & Milk
content.description: A warming blend of spiced chai and milk. Notes of cinnamon, ginger, and cardamom make this one you'll reach for on repeat.

content.name: Caramel Blondie
content.subtitle: Caramel & Vanilla
content.description: A smooth, golden espresso drink layered with rich caramel syrup and a hint of vanilla. Sweet enough to feel like a treat, balanced enough to be your everyday go-to.

content.name: 151 Caramel Mocha
content.subtitle: Caramel, Chocolate Milk
content.description: Our signature mocha - bold espresso, real caramel, and chocolate milk come together in the drink that helped put 151 on the map. Classic for a reason.

content.title: Seasonal
content.description: Seasonal drinks, here for a limited time only. Grab them before they're gone.

content.title: Treats
content.description: House-baked cookies and fresh breads. The kind of thing you add to your order and don't regret.

content.title: Teas
content.description: Brewed fresh and flavored to order. From sweet and simple to fruity and bold, there's a tea for every kind of day.

content.title: Smoothies
content.description: Blended thick to order. Sweet, filling, and good enough to count as breakfast. We won't judge.

content.title: Refreshers
content.description: Light, fruity, and made to cool you down. Real fruit purees and coconut cream over ice. No caffeine, all flavor.

content.title: Kids
content.description: Simple, familiar favorites made just for the little ones. No caffeine, no fuss. Just something they'll love.

content.title: Hot Food
content.description: Real food made for the morning rush. Burritos, bagels, biscuits, and more. Fresh, hot, and ready to go.

content.title: Energy
content.description: Real fruit flavors mixed into an energy base with a kick. Bold, colorful, and built to get you moving.

content.title: Dirty Pop
content.description: Your favorite sodas taken somewhere new. Flavored syrups, cream, and fruit purees turn a classic into something you won't forget.

content.title: Cold Brew
content.description: Slow-steeped for 18 hours. Smoother, bolder, and less acidic than iced coffee. Drink it straight or dressed up.

content.title: Coffee
content.description: Espresso-based drinks built around bold shots and real flavor. Classic lattes, signature mochas, and everything in between.
